messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: p99 latency > 6.0s for inference-prod (eu-west) — SLO burn=15% over 5m, alerts=firing. service: inference-prod.p99_latency. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: Incident INC12345 created (auto-ack disabled)

maria (oncall): acked. i'm on it, grabbing metrics + recent deploys.

maria (oncall): quick check — any deploys in last 10m?

jon (sre): not from infra, but there was a model rollout 7m ago (rollout-id: r-2026-03-15-21). could be related.

kevin (runtime): seeing KV cache eviction spikes and high sidecar CPU on tokenizers-*. logs: `tok-evict rate=820/s` and `sidecar_cpu=95%` on node eu-w-7

ash (prod-eng): customers reporting slow responses intermittently; product routed some requests to the canary variant earlier.

maria (oncall): good catch. switching traffic off canary now. @kevin can you confirm fallback path?

kevin (runtime): doing quick traffic shift to stable variant (route: inference-prod -> model-v1). executing: `reroute set inference-prod stable`

jon (sre): running quick KV cache warm on stable hosts to reduce cold misses. command: 
```
for host in $(cat /tmp/stable-hosts); do curl -s http://$host/warm?prefix=common || true; done
```

kevin (runtime): started warm job, also lowering batch size from 32 -> 8 on affected pools to reduce latency tails. config snippet: `batching.max_messages=8`

incident-bot: Alert update: p99 latency reduced to ~3.2s after reroute and batch change (1m window) — SLO burn down to 6%

maria (oncall): nice. keep monitoring for 10m. if p99 stays <4s we can stop active mitigation.

ash (prod-eng): customer-impact note: external API requests to /generate show 15% error/timeout increase during peak 20:58-21:04. tickets being triaged.

jon (sre): seeing one noisy host (eu-w-7) with repeated KV eviction and IO wait. manual cordon and drain in progress: `kubectl drain eu-w-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

kevin (runtime): drain started, autoscaler provisioning 2 extra pods in eu-west (dedicated pool)

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Acknowledgement recorded by maria (oncall) at 1762123475

maria (oncall): handing off to next rotation in 20m. if things look stable in 15m i'll close the PD incident otherwise escalate to eng-sre.

jon (sre): creating short runbook entry in incidents repo and linking to PD: https://incidents.internal/INC12345-runbook

kevin (runtime): follow-up actions: 1) investigate eviction root cause (hotkeys?) 2) long-term: adjust cache eviction policy, 3) consider ongoing canary throttling.

ash (prod-eng): customer comms: prepping a short note for affected customers, will post to status page if we see recurrence.

maria (oncall): last check — p99=2.9s over 2m, p95=1.1s, errors trending down. leaving PD incident open for 30m post-stable. handing off to @sre-rotation for overnight watch. thanks all :thumbsup:

sre-rotation: ack — will watch metrics and pick up if alert flares. will escalate to eng-sre if p99 > 5s again.

incident-bot: Note: follow-up task created: /tasks/INC12345-postmortem (owner: jon).
